events.title: Fall Pop-Up Market
events.description: This is the 6th annual Fall Art and Craft Pop-up Market in the Reems Creek Pottery Studio parking lot. With over 20 vendors and lots of parking, it’s a great place to start your holiday shopping or treat yourself to something special. Shop locally made by the people or who selling. There will be a variety of items from pottery (5 potters at Reems Creek Pottery), fine art, up cycled, tote bags, mittens, cards, crotchet, cork, jewelry, candles, soaps and more.
